headlines.headline: NBA preseason tips off tonight, Giannis cleared to play for Heat
headlines.detail: Miami hosts Toronto at 7 PM ET on NBA TV to open the 2026-27 preseason. Nets lottery pick Mikel Brown Jr. remains out with a sprained ankle; Cameron Payne signed with Turkey's Anadolu Efes.

headlines.headline: 49ers owner Jed York suspended six games, fined $500,000
headlines.detail: The NFL disciplined York for violating the personal conduct policy ahead of a full Week 4 Sunday slate. Justin Jefferson (ankle) is out for Minnesota; Jayden Daniels sidelined again for Washington's London trip.

headlines.headline: No. 5 Ohio State routs No. 14 Iowa 31-14 in Week 5 headliner
headlines.detail: Notre Dame beat UNC 37-26, Georgia handled Vanderbilt 38-14, and Minnesota pulled the day's biggest upset over Michigan, 20-14. Alabama and Georgia (both 4-0) are early favorites to host College GameDay in Week 6.

headlines.headline: Kentucky emerges as frontrunner for five-star Paul Osaruyi
headlines.detail: Top 2026 recruit Osaruyi left an in-home visit impressed with Kentucky. Iowa State transfer Milan Momcilovic is returning for a final season; the 2026-27 campaign tips off Nov. 1 with the Pac-12 back in action.
